lines.text: In the seventh year, elders of Israel came to inquire of the LORD, but He refused to be consulted.
God made Himself known to Israel in Egypt, but they kept the idols of Egypt, and He led them out.
Israel profaned His Sabbaths in the wilderness, yet God looked on them with pity and did not destroy them.
God swore to scatter the children among the nations, and the fathers' high place was called Bethel.
God said all Israel would serve Him on Mount Sinai, and He would accept them as a pleasing aroma.
